body: We trained Agaram 2.5B, a 2.5-billion-parameter Tamil-English language model, from scratch on about 50 billion tokens (58% Tamil, the rest English, math, code and parallel text) on one node of eight H100 GPUs in about six days, with a new tokenizer that, unlike our first model's, keeps line breaks. Supervised fine-tuning on 134,428 conversations, whose replies an open-weight teacher model wrote, and three short targeted rounds turned it into a chat model that answers in Tamil script, romanized Tamil (Tanglish) and English and can call tools: on 25 tool prompts whose schemas appear in training it picks the right tool 23 times and gives exactly the expected arguments 13 times. The released model translates better than Sarvam-1, a 2B Indic base model, in all six FLORES and IN22 directions (FLORES chrF 54.3 into Tamil and 55.2 into English, against 49.2 and 44.2), and nearly doubles its base model on native-Tamil IndicIFEval (19.3% from 10.0%). It is weak on knowledge: reading-comprehension and knowledge benchmarks sit near chance, and on 50 held-out everyday questions written by one native speaker, one LLM judge rated 46% of its replies usable (22-24 of 50 over three passes; 95% interval for 23 of 50, 33-60%), with nearly every failure a wrong fact. Our two further SFT experiments changed answer format but not the knowledge measures. We also describe our first model, Agaram 1.5B, whose failures shaped the choices here; how the judge's scores varied between passes on identical replies; and, item by item, what the targeted rounds trained against and where frontier-model text entered the data. The project ran on compute credits and our own funds, about USD 13,300 across both models; the weights are released (licence to be announced after legal review), with GGUF files for llama.cpp, at https://huggingface.co/murai-labs/agaram-2.5b-instruct; code at https://github.com/Murai-Labs/Agaram2.5b
summaryZh: Agaram 2.5B是一个从零训练的泰米尔语-英语双语模型，仅使用8张H100 GPU在6天内完成训练。该模型不仅支持泰米尔语脚本和罗马化泰米尔语，还具备工具调用能力。在基准测试中，其翻译性能优于现有的Indic模型，并在特定任务中表现良好。尽管在事实性知识方面仍有局限，但该项目以极低的成本（约1.3万美元）展示了为代表性不足语言构建专用模型的可行路径，并开源了权重。

aiReview.reasonZh: Agaram 2.5B展示了在低资源语言上通过高效训练实现工具调用能力的路径，具有参考价值。

glossary.explanationZh: 工具调用，指模型根据指令调用外部函数或API的能力。
监督微调，使用标注数据对预训练模型进行特定任务的优化。
代表性不足语言，指在主流预训练语料中占比极低的语言。
分词器，将文本转换为模型可处理的数字序列的组件。
